info.title: CodeTrack API
info.description: CodeTrack API with mounted account, session, learning-log, goal, dashboard, health and readiness routes. Protected resources belong to the signed-in user. Browser clients must include credentials. Email delivery uses Mailtrap; failed deliveries can be retried through resend-verification or forgot-password.

post.description: Validate input, hash the password and create the account. Send a verification link valid for 24 hours. Duplicate emails return 409, including concurrent registrations. Delivery failure returns 201 with verificationEmailSent=false so the client can offer resend.

accessCookie.name: codetrack_access
accessCookie.description: HttpOnly access cookie, Path=/api/v1, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production. Cookie and JWT expire after 15 minutes. A non-revoked database session is required.

refreshCookie.name: codetrack_refresh
refreshCookie.description: HttpOnly refresh cookie, Path=/api/v1/auth, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production. Expires after 7 days and rotates on refresh. Previous-token reuse revokes the session.
